## Summary & Positioning

Samir Shaikh is an AI Backend Engineer and AI SDE based in Gujarat, India, with production experience architecting scalable, event-driven backend systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. Experienced in leading full lifecycle development from technical discovery to production deployment, Samir focuses on Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) and AI Backend roles where engineering rigor solves ambiguous, customer-critical business challenges.

## Background & Experience

### Xira Infotech — Full Stack Engineer Intern (Aug 2026 – Present)
- Owned end-to-end delivery of a dynamic job portal from PostgreSQL schema design through the Next.js UI, covering job listings, advanced search/filtering, resume management, and application-tracking workflows.
- Built secure role-based authentication, authorization (RBAC), and admin dashboards, giving internal teams direct operational control without engineering bottlenecks.
- Integrated real-time notifications and payment gateway workflows, turning the portal into a transactional product.
- Designed REST APIs and backend architecture with continuous latency profiling and performance tuning to keep response times low.

### LOGICWIND — Back End Developer Intern (Sep 2025 – May 2026 · Surat, Gujarat, India)
- Migrated legacy packages and re-engineered core modules across 5+ production microservice and Firebase-based applications, cutting technical debt and improving deployment reliability across active codebases.
- Integrated Dittofeed, Reoon, and OneSignal into existing backend systems, enabling customer engagement pipelines and reducing invalid signups at the API layer.
- Worked across microservice, monolithic, and serverless (Firebase) architectures, gaining direct production exposure to distributed service communication patterns.
- Profiled and refactored API integration patterns and query paths, reducing response latency on key service endpoints.
- Shipped backend features within sprint cycles in an Agile team, participating in code reviews with minimal post-release defects.

## AI, LLM & Agentic Stack

- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Production RAG pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search, context compression, hallucination mitigation.
- **Vector Search & Embeddings**: PostgreSQL `pgvector` (HNSW & IVFFlat indexing, cosine distance similarity), Google Gemini `gemini-embedding-2` (3072 dimensions).
- **Agentic AI & Orchestration**: Autonomous multi-step agents, function calling/tool execution, dynamic reflection, structured JSON schema outputs.
- **Frameworks & SDKs**: Vercel AI SDK, Google Gemini API, Groq Cloud API, OpenAI API.
- **Observability & Evaluation**: Context grounding metrics, token efficiency tracking, prompt engineering, structured error boundaries.

## Featured Production Projects

### 1. Portfolio AI Assistant & RAG Pipeline
- **Role & Stack**: Creator — Next.js 16, TypeScript, Neon PostgreSQL + pgvector, Gemini Embeddings, Groq AI Chat.
- **Metrics & Benchmarks**: Indexes ~10,000 document chunks with strict cosine distance filtering (<= 0.5); achieves sub-300ms vector retrieval and grounding latency.
- **Key Architecture**: Dynamic context grounding with live GitHub activity injection and in-memory rate limiting with FingerprintJS fraud detection.
- **URL**: https://samir-portfolio-dev.vercel.app

### 2. WhatsApp Business Campaign & Automation Platform
- **Role & Stack**: Lead Backend Engineer — Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, whatsapp-web.js, Redis.
- **Metrics & Production Impact**: In live production for a regional business handling 1,000+ customer messages per week with zero message dropouts.
- **Key Architecture**: Session persistence, automated scheduling queues, rate-limit throttling to prevent account flagging, and real-time delivery webhooks.

### 3. AI Ticket Triage & Routing System
- **Role & Stack**: Backend Architect — Node.js, Express, Apache Kafka, BullMQ, PostgreSQL, Docker, OpenTelemetry.
- **Key Architecture**: Asynchronous microservices pipeline that categorizes incoming support tickets using LLMs and dispatches them via Kafka queues with BullMQ worker retry semantics.
- **Observability**: End-to-end distributed tracing instrumented with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics collection, and Grafana dashboarding.

### 4. Eventify Platform
- **Role & Stack**: Full-Stack Backend Developer — GraphQL API, Node.js, PostgreSQL, React.
- **Key Architecture**: Role-based access control (RBAC), transactional ticket booking with concurrency locks, and automated email confirmation notifications.

## Engineering Principles

1. **Production Reliability Over Demo Hype**: Building AI systems that remain deterministic, secure, observable, and rate-limited under real-world traffic.
2. **Grounding & Zero Hallucination Tolerances**: Using strict distance thresholds, verifiable context injection, and citation anchors for AI outputs.
3. **End-to-End Ownership**: Translating ambiguous business problems directly into robust backend code, tests, telemetry, and automated deployment pipelines.
4. **Clean Domain Boundaries**: Decoupling ingestion, embedding generation, vector storage, retrieval re-ranking, and inference for maintainability.
